findings.summary: _assert_one_treatment re-derives the differing-dimension computation that reckon/crew/worker_behaviour.py:162 behave_identically owns, rather than building on it; the two can drift.

The comparison iterates only the reference backend's keys and uses treatment.get, so a dimension present only in a non-reference backend would be missed; the previous full-dict equality caught that. Not reachable today because WorkerBehaviour.dimensions() returns a fixed key set.
